prompt.task: Design the first three experiments for a new target before any target outcome is known. Optimize early best-so-far AUC first and final-best outcome second across the fixed sequential budget.

execution_protocol.later_rounds: The LLM will choose one experiment per round from a menu containing GP-UCB, source-prior, and geometric candidates.

decision_rules: Select exactly three unique IDs from candidate_shortlist.
Keep hypothesis and mechanism under 55 words each.
Use exactly three candidate assessments and keep each reason under 25 words.
Use at most three failure conditions and keep each under 25 words.
Select at least one candidate ranked in the top five by source evidence.
Use one plausible quality anchor, one mechanism discriminator, and one geometry probe.
The three candidates must include at least two public categorical condition signatures when possible.
At least one pair must differ materially in normalized numeric conditions.
Do not cluster all three candidates in the same local operating region.
Candidate assessments must cover all three selected candidates.
Source scores are priors, not target measurements. Never invent target outcomes.
prompt.evidence_boundary: No target outcomes are present in this prompt.

"hypothesis": "FreeSolv-derived source ranks anti-transfer to lipophilicity: halogen-rich, low-heteroatom neutral aromatics (source-bottom) will outscore source-top polar amide/piperazine candidates on normalized logD.",
"mechanism": "Hydration free energy rewards hydrogen-bonding polar groups; octanol/water logD rewards their absence. Both read the same desolvation axis with opposite sign, so halogen and aromatic bins should flip direction while polarity bins keep predictive power.",
"selected_source_view": "all_sources",
"selected_candidate_ids": ["lipo_3444", "lipo_3424", "lipo_3465"],
"candidate_assessments": [
{"candidate_id": "lipo_3444", "role": "quality_anchor", "expected_outcome": 72.0, "confidence": 0.55, "reason": "Top-five source rank plus neutral chlorothiazole-anisole-acetamide scaffold; no ionizable group, moderate-high lipophilicity expected."},
{"candidate_id": "lipo_3424", "role": "mechanism_probe", "expected_outcome": 82.0, "confidence": 0.5, "reason": "Source-worst dichlorophenol directly tests sign inversion; halogen-mid, hetero-low, small nonpolar surface favors high logD."},
{"candidate_id": "lipo_3465", "role": "geometry_probe", "expected_outcome": 50.0, "confidence": 0.35, "reason": "Extreme geometry: very long, non-aromatic, hetero-high statin acid maps an unexplored numeric corner of the design space."}
],
"failure_conditions": [
"lipo_3424 scores below lipo_3444, contradicting the source-rank inversion claim.",
"Halogen-rich candidates underperform polar amides, invalidating the desolvation-axis mechanism.",
"lipo_3465 outscores both aromatics, indicating size, not polarity, drives logD."
],
"confidence": 0.5
}
